title.narrative: Sanad project to care for orphans affected by the conflict in Yemen

description.narrative: Ensuring continuity of support for orphans and achieving sustainability in the project, enabling them to live independently and contribute to the development of society. Achieving sustainability in the project requires focusing on building the orphans’ capacities, enabling them to gain financial and psychological independence, developing the community support network and local partnerships, and providing the necessary resources. It also requires organizing workshops, ongoing training, and continuous communication with the orphans, the local community, and partners in the project, in order to ensure continuity of support and achieve sustainability in the project.

Improving the humanitarian situation of orphans and providing a safe and stable environment for them, working to educate them and enable them to participate effectively in society, and facilitate their livelihoods through a number of activities and programs.

The project aims to improve the situation of orphans in light of the interruption of care for them and the economic collapses that the country is going through, which greatly affect the orphans, and to provide the necessary support for them to achieve financial and psychological independence and contribute to the development of society. The project mainly targets displaced and affected orphans
